title: Berkeley 2026 relocation assistance payment adjustment
requirement: Owners who evict tenants for owner move-in or to remove a property from the rental market under the Ellis Act must pay relocation assistance; for 2026 the standard payment is $19,413 and the additional payment for qualifying households is $6,471.
coverage_conditions: Tenants evicted through owner move-in evictions or Ellis Act evictions under the Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance and the Ellis Implementation Ordinance.

applicability.per_tenancy: Relocation assistance owed for owner move-in and Ellis Act evictions

quoted_span:
